# Flow Board

> Flow Board is a simple, private Kanban board web app for tracking tasks across four columns: Backlog, In Progress, In Review and Done.

## What it does
- Create, edit, delete (with undo) and move task cards, by drag-and-drop or a keyboard-accessible dropdown.
- Each card has a title, assignee, priority (High, Medium, Low), due date and tags.
- Filter by tag and search by title or assignee. Overdue cards are highlighted.
- Accessible: keyboard operable, screen-reader labelled, WCAG 2.2 AA colour contrast.

## Access and privacy
- Sign-in with email and password is required. Each user can only read and write their own cards (enforced by database row level security).
- Only the sign-in/landing page is public. Boards are private and not indexable.
